decisions.statement: An argument this change was handed no value for is refused by its key.
The page types declaring the property are handed in one to a line.
A line with nothing on it is read over.
A call naming no page type is refused.
`required` and `many` are handed in as text and handed on as truths.
A default the caller states nowhere is handed on as nothing.
The whole making is worked out by the one rung this change reaches.
That rung is reached through the runner rather than by importing that rung's code.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.

definition: one page property made, with its page, its part, every declaration of it and every page's key
